{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Dos Caminos Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Apr2024.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Webb County, Texas to Freer (KMTP compressor station), Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ir.kindermorgan.com/news/news-details/2023/Kinder-Morgan-and-Howard-Energy-Partners-Announce-Expansions-of-Their-Respective-Eagle-Ford-Natural-Gas-Transportation-Systems/default.aspx|title=ir.kindermorgan.com|website=ir.kindermorgan.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Dos Caminos LLC<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ir.kindermorgan.com/news/news-details/2023/Kinder-Morgan-and-Howard-Energy-Partners-Announce-Expansions-of-Their-Respective-Eagle-Ford-Natural-Gas-Transportation-Systems/default.aspx|title=ir.kindermorgan.com|website=ir.kindermorgan.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''1,000 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Apr2024.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''51 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Apr2024.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://ir.kindermorgan.com/news/news-details/2023/Kinder-Morgan-and-Howard-Energy-Partners-Announce-Expansions-of-Their-Respective-Eagle-Ford-Natural-Gas-Transportation-Systems/default.aspx|title=ir.kindermorgan.com|website=ir.kindermorgan.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjectsAug2026.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Apr2024.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
